svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Inside a transformer block
svg.desc: One transformer block: token and position embeddings flow into multi-head self-attention, then add and normalize, then a feed-forward network, then add and normalize again, producing the block output. Residual connections skip around both sub-layers. A bracket shows the block repeats N times.

g.text: One block, repeated N times. Dashed lines are residual connections.
